interface.longDescription: REMAKE by objekts helps develop film ideas and revise shots, blocking, editing and sound from creator-provided material. It preserves author constraints, separates observations from proposals and suggests practical tests. The public MCP provides stateless draft and source-reference checks; real host perception, independent professional quality and authenticated cross-session storage remain separate acceptance requirements.
